mechanism: Cobicistat inhibits CYP3A4 and may increase chlorthalidone levels; concurrent use increases risk of electrolyte abnormalities and hypotension due to additive effects on renal function and fluid/electrolyte balance.
action: Monitor electrolytes (potassium, sodium), renal function, and blood pressure regularly; consider alternative antihypertensive if clinically feasible or adjust chlorthalidone dosing based on response.
